Thanks!

--Margaret.

---------------------- Forwarded by Margaret Thomas on 10/01/2025 
09:26 ---------------------------


"Renault, Susan" <susan.renault@velzengroup.edu> on 24/12/2024 10:59
To: "aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr" <aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr>
cc: "margaret.thomas@lumieresante.fr" <margaret.thomas@lumieresante.fr>
Subject: RE: Marseille Clinical Strategy


Dear Aimé / Margaret,

Thanks for coming to Lyon to present an overview of the initiatives. We 
enjoyed meeting you and your colleagues and look forward to working with 
Lumière Santé. I would also like to pass on my team's appreciation for the
dinner as
well.

We wanted to give you an update on our project and get some feedback and 
additional information prior to our upcoming visit to Marseille on January
17th. Our project is going to be geared to the 3rd option you mentioned. We
plan on addressing some part of the Oncology Department business.  We are 
considering two options regarding this topic and would like to pursue either
(i) how patients are referred and recommending new clinical pathways and ways
to
serve outpatient care, OR
(ii) studying the supply chain of medical supplies and coming up with
recommendations for areas
for further investments.

However, we would like to get some more information on the Outpatient Services
before truly scoping the project. We are also very open to
suggestions, especially if you had a much broader or different scope in mind; 
so please let us know.

We have not yet reviewed the introductory information received last week, but 
here are the questions we have specific to the Oncology unit:

Can we look at its overall service plan or a more detailed summary than is 
in the annual report?
What is the pricing philosophy/overall billing structure?
Who are the referring physicians and how are patients acquired?
What would patients be doing if they did not come to Lumière Santé?
What are the international expansion plans and capabilities?
Is there any important regulatory summary information we can have?

If this information is not already covered in the review material you sent, 
will you be able to recommend other sources where we may find such
information?

After we have reviewed the material sent to us recently, we may want to 
schedule a phone call with you and/or one of your colleagues directly 
involved in the Oncology business. I would like to call you in 
the new year to discuss this further. In the meantime, please feel free to 
call me at +33 4 59 27 70 77 if you need any information.

Regards,
Clinical Strategy Team
Ram
Dennis
Jason
Omar
Steve
Clay
